segment_detail.title: Segment
segment_detail.body:
- **B2B vs B2C mix: ~80–82% B2B / ~18–20% B2C.** B2B (dealer/distribution, MCPL own brand, no white-labeling) remains the revenue core and grows fastest (new design can sell within ~15 days).
- Imported marble (Marmi Bella / "Italian marble" division) cited as the key driver of rising B2C contribution and higher margins vs tiles; backward-integration cutting/polishing has spare capacity (can do job-work for local players).
- Geography: ~900+ dealers concentrated West & South India; 6 premium experience centers (>1,26,500 sq ft); >1,000 SKUs.

order_book.title: Order book / pipeline
order_book.body: - No formal order book disclosed (distribution/retail model). Pipeline signals: African export tie-ups under contractual negotiation (West & South-zone Africa); markets in Burundi, Angola, Sudan, Senegal, Uganda being developed; Dubai Display Center as GCC/Middle East-Africa gateway; turnkey "supply & fixing" project division added.

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)
guidance.body:
- **Revenue/volume:** Reiterated **25–30% CAGR** growth target (maintained since first post-listing call); FY26 volumes grew ~23–24%. Same pace guided into FY27.
- **Margins:** Expects EBITDA/PAT margins to **improve in FY27** driven by premium products (Marmi Bella marble, customized tiles), backward integration and exports. **REFUSED to quantify** steady-state EBITDA margin for FY27/28 or beyond ("I'll not be able to quantify").
- **Exports:** Export team deployed since ~Oct (mid-FY26); expects export operations to become **operational in first 6 months of FY27**; first focus West & Southern Africa region.
- **Working capital:** Guided continued tightening of debtor/inventory days off the improved FY26 base; targets undisclosed.
- No explicit Capex guidance ("stay tuned for announcements") — analyst pushed for granular Capex/segment disclosure; management declined.

growth_optionality.title: Growth / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **Exports** (Africa-West/South, GCC via Dubai center, UK mention) — biggest optionality; institutional/sovereign-level opportunities cited.
- **Premiumization** — Marmi Bella imported marble, next-gen quartz, customized tiles for architects/builders at higher margin.
- **MCPL Studio** AI visualization (2D/3D panoramic, upload-your-space) — built ~4–5 yrs ago; drives faster B2C conversion, free vs architect fees.
- **Backward integration** (Upper Thane cutting/polishing) — turnaround cut from 10–12 days to ~24 hrs; margin and retention lever.
- Pan-India physical store expansion (touch-and-feel still essential in India; online tile sales "not yet" viable).

margins.title: Margins & cost
margins.body:
- H2 EBITDA margin fell ~300 bps YoY (to ~11%) due to: (1) low-margin new design tiles introduced to drive volume; (2) high-volume/low-margin service/project contracts with discounts passed on.
- A planned "technological advancement product" that would have carried better margins was **delayed in production**, pushing margin restoration to FY27.
- Morbi gas-supply disruption (Iran war geopolitics) hit production at Morbi cluster; MCPL mitigated via pre-planned/pre-ordered group-manufacturer stock; tile prices raised ~15–20 days in late-March and passed to customers; **management says no adverse volume/margin impact "so far."**

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- **Long-term borrowings cut ₹28.98 Cr → ₹13.89 Cr** (−52%) — deleveraging is the standout FY26 capital-allocation move.
- Working capital cycle improved ~44%; debtor days 163→114; trade receivables ~₹63 Cr despite higher volume.
- **All promoter warrants converted** (last remaining warrant converted) — equity infusion / no overhang.
- Priorities FY27: profit growth, stronger cash flow generation, further WC optimization, disciplined capital deployment.

management_tone.title: Management tone
management_tone.body:
- Confident, promotional, "promise-keeping" framing; repeatedly invokes "we keep our promises," "white hair / senior + youth," and brand-building narrative.
- **Evasive on quantification** — deflected hard analyst questions on margin bridge, % of low-margin revenue, steady-state margins, receivables aging, and Capex ("balance sheet will be public soon," "stay tuned," "cannot quantify"). Answers often discursive/qualitative.
- Acknowledged margin pressure honestly but framed as temporary/strategic.

risks.title: Risks
risks.body:
- **Cash flow from operations still negative (~ −₹35 Cr)** per analyst (management did not dispute) — despite receivable-day improvement, CFO remains negative; working-capital-intensive growth.
- EBITDA stagnation: revenue +23% but absolute EBITDA roughly flat → operating deleverage / margin quality concern.
- Heavy B2B concentration (~80%+) and dependence on Morbi supply (gas/geopolitical disruption risk).
- No own manufacturing — dependent on contract manufacturers; pricing pass-through ability tested in disruptions.
- **Disclosure quality risk:** management repeatedly declined to quantify segment mix %, margin guidance, receivables aging, and Capex; analysts explicitly requested more granularity.
- Export execution unproven (team only deployed mid-FY26; contracts still being signed).

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious
non_obvious.body:
- Management benchmarked its model to **Tesco (UK)** — i.e., a logistics/distribution-led retailer with small own-brand and large store/logistics network — signaling ambition to be a surface-solutions "retailer" not a tile manufacturer.
- The "temporary" low-margin push was partly deliberate volume-grab to hit the 25–30% CAGR promise — i.e., growth was bought with margin.
- Delayed "technological advancement product" is a hidden FY27 swing factor for margin recovery.
- Spare backward-integration capacity could become a B2B job-work revenue line for rival local players.

challenges.title: Challenges → beneficiaries
challenges.body:
- Morbi gas-supply / production disruption (Iran-war geopolitics) → benefits players with pre-stocked inventory & asset-light distributors able to pass through price (MCPL claims to benefit); pressures pure manufacturers dependent on continuous gas.
- Premiumization & customization demand from architects/builders → beneficiaries: value-add processors (cutting/polishing), imported-marble/quartz suppliers, AI-design-tool enablers.
- ✅ / ⭐ tagged beneficiaries: (none formally tagged)

qoq_log.title: QoQ / HoH Log
qoq_log.body: - **H2 FY26 (this call):** Rev ₹120.82 Cr (+23.3% YoY); EBITDA ₹13.45 Cr (~11% margin, −300 bps YoY); PAT ₹6.14 Cr. FY26 full: Rev ₹202.99 Cr (+23.4%), EBITDA ₹24.88 Cr (~flat YoY), PAT ₹12.01 Cr (+10.1%). LT debt ₹28.98→₹13.89 Cr; debtor days 163→114; WC cycle −44%; all warrants converted. CFO still ~ −₹35 Cr (per analyst). Key watch items into FY27: margin recovery via premium/marble/customized mix, exports going live (Africa) in H1 FY27, delayed tech product launch, Capex announcements, and whether low-margin service volumes recur. Management reiterated 25–30% revenue CAGR; declined margin/Capex quantification.
